rationale: C06 supplies a concrete, material drafting template for the child. The child closely follows its national campaign description, appointment of a Federal Vice Chairman, cooperation formula, detailed solicitation and collection machinery, statement about the Government's full citizen's share, single-appeal rationale, and closing request for thoughtful and generous giving. C05 and C12 share substantial language and structure, but C06 contains the fullest combination of the child's distinctive provisions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: United Funds and Community Chests this fall will make their annual appeals throughout the country and among Federal civilian and military personnel for the support of more than 28,000 health, welfare and recreation organizations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This Fall more than 2,000 United Funds and Community Chests will make their appeals for the support of over 23,000 health, welfare and recreation organizations... Their campaigns will be conducted... among federal, civilian and military personnel
shared_material.explanation: The opening framework and enumerated beneficiary categories are closely parallel, with updated campaign figures.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Many of these campaigns will include such national agencies as the Red Cross, USO, and others working to eliminate disease and secure the health of us all.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Many of these campaigns will include the needs of such national agencies as the Red Cross, USO and those fighting the dread diseases and other health problems.
shared_material.explanation: The same sequence of named national agencies and disease-related organizations is adapted with modest wording changes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such cooperation should, under the Federal policy on voluntary fund-raising, include the effective solicitation of all employees, the acceptance of equitable unit goals, and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Such cooperation should, under the new uniform Federal policy on fund raising, include the effective solicitation of all employees, the acceptance of equitable unit goals, and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly verbatim and constitutes distinctive administrative machinery rather than merely shared subject matter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: We who work in the Government want to assume our full citizen's share of the voluntary support of health and welfare services. The United Fund and Community Chest campaigns provide us with an opportunity to contribute to a wide variety and a large number of organizations through a single appeal.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We who work in the Government want to assume our full citizen's share of voluntary support of the many worthwhile private health and welfare organizations. The United Fund and Community Chest campaigns provide us with an opportunity for supporting a wide variety and a large number of organizations through a single appeal.
shared_material.explanation: Two consecutive sentences are reused almost verbatim as the campaign's civic rationale.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope that employees of your department in each community where it conducts its operations will give thoughtfully and generously to these campaigns.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my hope that all employees will give thoughtfully and generously to these campaigns.
shared_material.explanation: The child's closing sentence directly expands C06's closing appeal.
